newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australian wool prices seen firm this week.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australian wool prices seen firm this week.

text.p: Australian wool prices are expected to continue to remain firm this week, Wesfarmers Dalgety Ltd said in its weekly market preview.

The eastern market indicator rose by 33 cents last week to 617 cents a kg clean, reaching the highest level for the season. Sales are in Sydney, Melbourne and Fremantle with a total 74,200 bales offered. Wesfarmers said there was a limited selection, particularly in Sydney with only a one day sale.
The preview said there was also a decreasing quantity available from Wool International where now 75 percent of the March quarter quota was complete.

The Australian Council of Wool Exporters said that while there was good demand for the best quality wools, exporters report that the overall market sentiment was being driven by the relatively small quantities rostered for sale in January.

"However, while the market is expected to remain firm, the relative tapering of prices towards the close of last week suggest that rises of the current magnitude are unlikely to continue and prices will adopt a gradual upward trend in the short term," Wesfarmers said.
